node.statement: For every finite exact signed idempotent P, every ordered pair (a,b) of points of the row polytope K(P) with a != b, every affine chi with chi(a) - chi(b) = 1, all reals A, Lambda > 0, and every set N of full row-point fibers with |chi(p_Q)| <= A for every Q in N and |chi(p_Q)| <= Lambda for every Q not in N, the complement F of N satisfies a^+(F) + b^+(F) >= (1 - A*l_chi)/Lambda - nu(a) - nu(b), where l_chi = sum_Q |d_Q| and d_Q = sum_{j in Q}(a_j - b_j).
